_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the $499 'Managed' tier
A is the price the tier is sold at. B is the PRO-block gate in
api/plans.py. C is the alias resolution in PlansConfig.get_plan -- the
`premium` rows must keep working. D and H are the two halves of the
A3 suppression: D stops derive_entitlements from consulting the
deferred list, H empties the list itself. E is the tier ladder, where
`premium` must stay on the same rung as `managed`. F and G are the
marketing page: the price the Managed card shows, and the false
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A: the Managed tier is priced at $490 instead of $499
B: managed is no longer a PRO-block plan
C: get_plan no longer resolves the premium alias
D: derive_entitlements ignores the deferred-permission list
mutations.replace: if False and permission in deferred_permissions:

mutations.label: E: the premium rung is lowered below managed
F: the marketing page prices the Managed card at $490
G: the marketing page advertises Portfolio backtesting on Standard again
H: the config's deferred-permission list is emptied
